decisions.reason: The gated-viewer decision does not change the existing Pinata/IPFS hosting or client-removability requirements.
The existing message-226 MODIFY already captures NFT metadata as a viewer entry point; read-only behavior and PDF.js navigation remain unchanged.
Ownership gating does not necessarily remove or alter the optional offline download, which can remain available to an authorized holder.
The existing message-226 MODIFY fully records that metadata points to an ownership-gated viewer rather than directly to the PDF.
The source decision establishes access enforcement but does not direct any change to FAQ content.
Automatic verification of current NFT ownership is compatible with book access transferring to a secondary buyer and does not change the transfer rules.
The gated-viewer decision does not require a change to the About page's existing product, process, technology, or vision copy.
Ebook ownership verification does not affect dashboard visibility of referral commissions.
The ebook viewer's automatic ownership check does not change fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, contents, or access methods.
The ebook access mechanism does not change referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout mode.
Automatic Lit Protocol ownership verification for ebook access does not change SIWE requirements for minting, transfers, or dashboard sign-in.
The gated-viewer decision does not affect allocation of commissions when no referral code is entered.
